messages:
ashley: Heads up — Deploybot just hit HOLD on events_v2_migration during the canary sweep. Seeing lock_wait spikes on canary-2 (~8-12s) so it tripped the threshold.

deploybot: [Automated] HOLD applied to migration events_v2_migration
Reason: lock_wait > 5s observed across 3 canary nodes
Canary tag: rb-24-03-billing
Logs:
```
2026-03-21T03:12:07Z canary-2 | lock_wait_avg=10.8s op=ALTER TABLE billing.events ADD COLUMN event_type text; rows=0
```

mike_db: On it. Early signal looks like a daily metrics job doing a full-table aggregate (created_at range) which is blocking the DDL. I captured a pg_stat_activity snapshot, top blocker: pid=5981 user=metrics_runner query="SELECT count(*) FROM billing.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01'" state=active wait=lock

kevin_sre: If it's that job, can we throttle it or pause for the window? We can also route canary traffic off canary-2 while retrying.

ashley: @mike_db can you paste the pg_locks / blocker chain so we know whether it's waiting for SHARE/ACCESS EXCLUSIVE? Need quick triage.

mike_db: Snapshot shows ALTER holding ACCESS EXCLUSIVE waiting on lower lock because of concurrent long SELECTs; classic: long read prevents fast DDL on older Postgres versions.

mike_db: Suggested mitigations (short):
- Pause the metrics cron for 30m (metrics_runner)
- Set statement_timeout=120000ms for metrics_runner once it resumes
- Retry migration after 15m soft-retry via deploybot

elena_release: Pausing the job is fine. Rolling back migration not preferred unless necessary.

sre-oncall: +1 pause + retry. If retry still sees >7s waits, fallback to plan: add column as NULLABLE with no backfill, ship app-side defaults, then run a controlled background backfill worker that updates in batches.

ashley: Decision: pause metrics job now (ashley executed), queue soft-retry for 18 minutes. If retry sees lock_wait > 7s, we abort and switch to nullable+bg-backfill. @deploybot please execute policy.

deploybot: RETRY scheduled in 1080s (soft). If HOLD persists at retry time, deploybot will mark MIGRATION_ABORT and post summary.

kevin_sre: I'm putting a temporary route rule in front of canary-2 to drain non-essential traffic during the retry window.

mike_db: Also recommending we temporarily lower maintenance_cluster.max_parallel_workers to reduce concurrency during the apply.

ashley: Release note draft/action items:
- billing.events: events_v2 column add attempted; initial canary attempt paused due to lock contention. Background backfill scheduled if immediate apply skipped.
Owners: mike_db (bg-backfill), elena_release (release notes).

elena_release: I'll add that to the release notes and create a follow-up ticket on the product board.

sre-oncall: If we end up aborting, we'll run a 60m blameless RCA to capture query patterns; set that as postmortem trigger.

ashley: Update: metrics job paused manually. Starting retry now.

deploybot: RETRY started @1748123630

mike_db: After pausing metrics_runner and draining canary-2, lock_waits dropped to ~0.9s on snapshot. Looks promising.

deploybot: RETRY status: APPLIED to canary set rb-24-03-billing — no further holds.

ashley: Great. Follow-ups: mike_db — schedule background backfill job (safe batching), kevin_sre — remove temporary route rule after 10m, elena_release — finalize release notes and link bg-backfill ticket.

kevin_sre: Temp rule removed.

mike_db: Will kick off bg-worker tomorrow 02:00 UTC with small batch size (1000 rows) and heartbeat logs to ticket.

elena_release: Release notes updated; included the brief pause and fallback plan. Thanks all :tada:

ashley: Closing once bg-backfill ticket gets first heartbeat. :thumbsup:
